svg.text: ICSSS — Intelligent Campus Security Surveillance System
UC-21 Finish or Cancel Approved Request
UC-30 View Incident Location on Map
UC-36 Check In and Out of Shift
UC-37 Request Shift Swap or Leave
Solid line: actor takes part in the use case
Hollow triangle: generalization (each role is a User)
Dashed «include»: always part of the base use case
Dashed «extend»: optional, only under a condition
